newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Azerbaijan to launch new T-bill issue on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Azerbaijan to launch new T-bill issue on Thursday.

text.p: Azerbaijan will launch a 30-day Treasury Bill issue on Thursday, a senior finance ministry official told Reuters on Wednesday.

A total of 13 billion manats worth of T-bills will be offered at an auction, held by the National (central) bank. The new issue is higher than the previous one, worth 11 billion manats. Each T-bill is worth one million manats.
It is only the third issue of T-bills in Azerbaijan.

The second issue yielded an average of 32.09 percent at the October 21 auction, just above 31.18 percent for the first issue, launched on September 20. Virtually all of the issues were placed immediately at auction.
